text: Hidden Tomb

One of our soldiers falls through a crack in the earth and lands in a great buried tomb. More are sent down with torches, and they come back laden with grave goods. Our lord takes the pick of them, and learns much from the carvings on the walls.
Abandoned Camp

Our vanguard finds an abandoned camp hidden between the hills, its tents still pitched and its stores still full. We check it for traps and find none, so the army rests and resupplies before moving on.
Buried Relics
A strange noise draws our scouts to a ruined village, where a passage opens beneath the old meeting hall. Inside lies a forgotten cache, and among the dust and bones is one prize worth the taking.
Hidden Temple

Deep in the ruins of an old city, one temple still has its roof and its doors. Our lord keeps vigil there for a night and a day, and walks out with a calm that settles over the whole army like a ward.
Caravan Remnants
Smoke rises not far from our camp. Our scouts find a caravan attacked but not fully sacked, its guards dead and its raiders long gone, and what they left behind is ours now.
Legendary Bard Rescued

A desperate rider begs us to save their village from a slaver raid. We arrive in time, and among the freed captives is a famous bard, who promises to sing of our deeds in every hall and market across the land.
A Voice in the Dream

Our lord's sleep is broken by a dream more vivid than any waking hour. A voice speaks of strength and of trials to come, and by morning the whole army fights as if nothing in the world could break it.
Challenge Won
The Explorers

A band of explorers asks to travel under the protection of our weapons until the road grows safer. In return they share their maps and their hard-won knowledge of the land, and our march grows swifter and surer.
The rival army yields the field, bruised and humbled. Their general salutes our strength before withdrawing, and word of the victory spreads through the ranks.
Challenge Declined
The rival general laughs and leads their army away, calling us cowards. Let us hope the insult is the worst that comes of it.
Smothered In The Crib

The nascent rebellion was quickly defeated before it could attract dangerous characters. Our general lets those who no longer have the will to fight disperse. They were never our true target, and now they better understand the difference between a mere belligerent mob and a real army.
A Band Of Weaklings Ignored

Our general laughs in their faces. We leave the camp of weaklings without laying a finger on them. They scatter quickly and desperately as we move away, the mere threat of our presence enough to cure their reckless stupidity.
Defeated Bandits
Dust settles over the field, and the bandits lie dead or in chains. Under the knife their leader gives up the lair, and everything his band ever stole now goes to our war effort.
An Uneventful Night

Come morning there are no more strange noises in the surroundings, just the expected sounds of the road. The advance party reports that behind the hill are the remains of a recently vacated camp. The bandits may have chosen not to attack at night due to the heavy guard posted by the general and the clear defensive position of the army. Maybe dodging them was for our own good?
Cropped Ears

The raiders lie dead where they fell, their arrows scattered through the grass. Our soldiers pick over the elven bows and cloaks, and learn how better to weather their volleys and stay hidden from their scouts. The lesson will not last forever, but it will serve us for a while.
A Suit of Scales

The lizardmen lie dead among the trampled villages, their great beasts sprawled beside them. Our soldiers study their scaled hides and stone-edged weapons, and learn how to shore up our defence and last longer in battle. It will not last, but for a while the army fights the better for it.
Drowned Twice

The drowned invaders lie still at last, and the stink of the tide is already fading from the field. Our soldiers pick through what the enemy's sea-magic left behind and learn a few things that could help us survive. It will fade in time, but for a while it should serve us.
Territorial Plunder

The raiders plunder the lands we are marching through. The locals drive them off in the end, but a trail of ruin is left across the territory. Here and at home alike, people now call us "The Dishonoured".
The Bull By The Horns
We caught the beastmen on their own ground and cut them down among the trees. The forest floor is red, and for once the woods are quiet. The soldiers come out of the skirmish in high spirits.
A Rat In The Trap

The skaven are masters of the ambush, but our army turned on them so fast that they broke on the spot. Many of the ratmen escaped into their tunnels, yet the dead pile high. Beating the skaven at their own game has the soldiers sure that luck is on our side.
Massacre Averted
The danger past, it turns out you avoided a likely deadly ambush. The enemies, seeing that the army was rapidly retreating, could not surround it and ended up abandoning their attack.
A Green Memory

The greenskins and their legendary leader lie on the ground, defeated and strangely content. Apparently it was a memorable battle for them. They give us a powerful artifact and tell us that they will see us again for the next battle!
A Fitting End

Dead dark elves cover the plain as far as the eye can see. Their slaver captains are gone, and it will be a long while before they raid these lands again. In their leader's tent our soldiers find artefacts that will serve us better than they served him.
Broken Bloodsucker Teeth

The necromancer and his few remaining followers fled as if they themselves had seen a ghost. The pile of bones left behind is so high that our wizards think it will take weeks to crumble away. An incredibly luxurious carriage, filled with relics, is the only thing left intact on the battlefield. It will be put to good use by our forces.
An Airy Tomb

By morning the risen dead who came to stop us lie still, while the rest of their host has vanished after the marauders. Among the fallen lie relics that may carry the same curse that set the dead on those raiders. Our lord judges them worth the risk, and we take them before marching on.
An Oath Fulfilled

We have helped the Slayers regain their honour. Somehow the legendary pair survived. Felix carries an unconscious Gotrek to safety while we finish off the last Slayer, for Gotrek's doom has not yet come. Will Felix write of this adventure, and what will he say about us?
Wise Retreat
We left behind the powerful and dangerous army that stood before us. We don't know what would have happened had we faced them, but at least we can be sure that we will live to fight another day.
A Gift from Khorne

Skarbrand begins to fade back into the Chaos he was born from. "WORTHY!" he seems to laugh as he fades away. "KHORNE SENDS HIS BLESSINGS TO YOU." He gives you a Khorne Cache. "FOR THE BATTLES TO COME."
From Beyond The Warp

The weapon before us is not of this world. Its teeth race around the blade too fast for the eye to follow, snarling like a beast, and they chew through anything held against them. It seems to grow hungrier with every kill. Such a thing cannot be left for others to find, so our lord keeps it close.
Khorne Understands You Want a Challenge
The Master of War looks upon your victory with appreciation. Khorne rewards the best warriors. Your army is reinvigorated and fortified. War calls you!
A Gift from Khorne

Valkia smiles as her last warrior falls. To the Khornate it does not matter where the blood flows, as long as it flows. She points to a stash half-hidden by the terrain near a forest. "Sooner or later you will serve. And I will delight in fighting by your side when you do." You watch her fly through the sky and disappear. Beautiful and terrible, she leaves you wondering what blessing awaits you.
The Damned Spear

The spear before us is plainly cursed, and it thrums with a power that sets the teeth on edge. When our lord grips the shaft, it feels ready to unleash ruin at a word. No one else can be allowed to wield it, so our lord keeps it close.
Khorne Understands You Want a Challenge
The Master of War looks upon your victory with appreciation. Khorne rewards the best warriors. Your army is reinvigorated and fortified. War calls you!
A Gift from Khorne

The daemons are defeated and vanish. They cannot believe their defeat as they desperately try to cling to reality. "Be'lakor will destroy me... NOOOOO!" The leader of the daemons drops a stash hidden on his back. The other daemons try to reach him, but as they get closer they burn and are quickly dispelled back into Chaos. The presence of the God of War urges you to approach the cursed treasure...
The Ever Regenerating Blade

Strange teeth line the whole edge of this blade. It feels alive in the hand, as if it has kept something of every life it ever took. We will not leave it for anyone else to claim, so it travels with our lord.
Khorne Understands You Want a Challenge
The Master of War looks upon your victory with appreciation. Khorne rewards the best warriors. Your army is reinvigorated and fortified. War calls you!
A Gift from Khorne

Azazel smiles. With the defeat of the armies following him, he feels the sword lose its power over him. "Have it if you want it. It's useful, but I don't like something about it. Well, it was fun while it lasted. I know who I can turn to when I need to get out of trouble." He smiles at you, and you feel strangely happy to see his smile. Seeing him fly away makes you feel somehow sad. You look at the sword... maybe you could put it to some use.
The Corrupted Blade

The sword is plainly cursed. Rage is worked into the blade, yet a wild, wanton streak still runs through it, left over from the Dark Prince before the Blood God claimed it. Our lord takes it, sooner than see it fall into other hands.
Azazel's Prank

There is nothing special about this sword. It appears to be a simple sword, useful but nothing more. You hear Azazel laugh in the distance. It seems that this time the daemon did it just for fun, but your troops still welcome the experience and the loot from defeating his pursuers.
A Gift from Khorne Rejected
Khorne's gaze falls heavy on our army. We turned from his challenge, and now shame and a murderous hunger gnaw at every warrior until their eyes cloud red. We should avoid battle for a while...
A Gift from Slaanesh

Sigvald flees in terror, cursing you. "Ugly creature, one day I will kill you and drink from your horrible skull!" Searching his camp, you find a stash that clearly seems to beckon you. Apparently Sigvald tried to open it, and when he couldn't, he left marks all over it in a fit of jealousy. It opens at the mere touch of your hands...
Slaanesh Wants Your Favour

A sword of unparalleled beauty lies before us, with none of the corruption we expected from its giver. It looks like the work of a smith obsessed with perfection and nothing else. Our lord tests it on Sigvald's tent and leaves it in ribbons, and the blade comes away without a mark. We take it with us.
Slaanesh Favours You
The Dark Prince finds you amusing. He blesses you for your strength and skill in fulfilling his desire. You feel strangely empowered. It seems he wishes you to amuse him further.
A Gift from Slaanesh

N'Kari shivers with delight at his own defeat. "I always love a good challenge!" He licks his lips slowly. "Enter the next room, your prize is waiting for you." He touches our lord's face, and the urge to obey is overwhelming. As our lord steps inside, the castle shakes and fades away, until only that one room remains. In that room our lord finds...
A Useful Follower

A strange man is writing in a beautiful little notebook. He has elven features, yet he also appears human, and you cannot place his race. He stops and greets you in an ostentatious manner. He shows extreme devotion to you, praising you whenever you wish and telling your troops of your greatness and glory. They seem motivated by his speeches, so you decide to take him with you on your travels.
Slaanesh Favours You
The Dark Prince finds you amusing. He blesses you for your strength and skill in fulfilling his desire. You feel strangely empowered. It seems he wishes you to amuse him further.
A Gift from Slaanesh

Morathi escapes, sacrificing part of her army to survive. With her betrayal foiled, we shouldn't see the dark elf again for some time. You feel a delighted laugh echo in your head. Without knowing how, you follow a path in the dark, protected by your best men. You find a broken carriage on the road and search it without thinking.
Slaanesh's Lover Joins You

Sitting in the carriage is a shackled woman of unparalleled beauty. You can't understand why, but looking at her you feel as if you are looking at not one but many women. She looks at you, and her face settles into that of a woman you find irresistible. You feel a shudder and a strange urge to protect her. You take her with you, not knowing exactly why but doing it anyway.
Slaanesh Favours You
The Dark Prince finds you amusing. He blesses you for your strength and skill in fulfilling his desire. You feel strangely empowered. It seems he wishes you to amuse him further.
A Gift from Slaanesh Rejected

A sensation of drowsiness and overwhelming debauchery takes hold of you. You feel the Dark Prince's disappointment and anger. You and your army don't seem ready to fight but feel compelled to do so. You must be careful which battles you fight...
A Dream Too Vivid

You wake up with a chill and cold sweat all over your body. The dream was extremely vivid and you feel the adrenaline still running through your body as if you had been about to go into combat. But it was just a dream, nothing more. You feel reinvigorated by a strange force and you understand that the dream vision will eventually pass. You must prepare for the battle to come!
A Tribute From The Smithy

My warmest regards, my lord. Thank you for protecting our smithy from our enemies and the dangers that surround us. The master blacksmith sends you the promised tribute for your investment and protection. Use it for your war effort!
Raiders Repelled
The incursion has been repelled and the invaders lie dead on the field. What they looted is returned to the land, and the army takes the lessons of the battle to heart.
Ambush Turned

They meant to catch us on the march, but our scouts spotted them first and we struck before the trap could close. The would-be ambushers are broken on their own ground, and the soldiers are in high spirits after the fight.
A Battle to Remember
The enemy army lies broken across the field. Among the spoils we find weapons and relics worth carrying into the wars to come.
Shoulder to Shoulder
The enemy breaks between our two armies and flees the field. Our allies salute us as they march away, and word of what we did here will reach their kin.
The Hunters Hunted
The ambush is broken before it could close. Our escort thanks us, and among the enemy's packs we find something worth keeping.
Relief at Last
We reached them in time. The enemy lies broken around our allies' last line, and their survivors hail us as saviours.
Left to Their Fate
We turned away and left our allies to face the enemy alone. We will never know how it ended for them, but our own army lives to fight another day.
Patron of the Guild
Our gift has been counted and recounted. Every tavern of the Guild has grown, and its keepers will not soon forget our name.
Great Patron of the Guild
No lord has given the Guild more. Every tavern has grown to its grandest, and they all drink to our name.
Patron of the Association
The Association's clerks have weighed our gift and stamped our name into their ledgers. Every smithy of the Association has grown, and its masters now greet our quartermasters like old friends.
Great Patron of the Association
Our name is now cut into the anvil of every smithy the Association runs, for no lord has given it more. Each one has grown to its grandest, and our orders go to the front of the queue.
Cast the Lots
The lots tumble from the cup and fall in our favour. The stranger who offered the game scowls, but pays up all the same, and a rare treasure changes hands.
Cast the Lots
The lots fall against us, as they so often do for newcomers. The stranger sweeps up our stake with a crooked grin and is gone before anyone thinks to argue.
Drink from the Spring
The water runs cold and clear from the rock. Wounds close and tired limbs grow strong again as the whole army drinks its fill.
Drink from the Spring
The water tastes of rot and old iron. Within hours sickness spreads through the camp, and the army will march weaker for some time.
Open the Sealed Door
The seal breaks and the door grinds open on a chamber untouched for centuries. At its heart, on a bare stone plinth, lies a treasure of legend.
Open the Sealed Door
The seal breaks, and so does the trap behind it. Our lord is caught in the blast and carried from the chamber, badly wounded.
Double or Nothing
The bet is called and the throw comes up in our favour. Our stake returns to the treasury doubled, and the house is not pleased about it.
Double or Nothing
The bet is called and the throw turns against us. Our stake is gone, and the house thanks us warmly for our custom.
Wake the Guardian
The great beast snorts and shifts its bulk, then sinks back into its slumber. We creep past it and make off with a rare treasure from its hoard.
Wake the Guardian
The ground shakes as the guardian of this place rises from its slumber. It sees intruders in its lair and charges, and our army must stand and fight!
Touch the Relic
Warmth spreads from the relic into the hands that hold it. A blessing settles over the army, and the soldiers march a little taller for it.
Touch the Relic
The relic is cold as a grave, and a creeping dread spreads through the ranks. A curse settles over the army, though it should not last long.
Gamble with the Hermit
The hermit squints at the dice, then laughs and shuffles off into the hut. They return with a unique treasure and press it into our hands.
Gamble with the Hermit
The hermit wins throw after throw, cackling all the while. When the game is done our gold is in the hermit's pouch, and the hermit is gone.
Endow the Province

Our gold pays for new roads and storehouses across [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. The region grows stronger and richer, and its people know who paid for it.
Garrison Drill

Fresh supplies reach the garrison of [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]], and its officers drill the defenders from dawn to dusk. Its walls are manned by harder soldiers now.
Raise the Settlement

Builders swarm over [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]], raising new halls and stronger walls. In a matter of days its heart stands a level higher than before.
Quell the Unrest

Our soldiers walk the streets of [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]], and the loudest troublemakers fall quiet. Order returns, for now.
Bountiful Harvest

The fields around [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]] groan under a bountiful harvest. Carts queue at the granaries for days, and the markets are busier than anyone can remember.
Stir Their Rebels

Our agents hand out grievances and weapons among the malcontents of [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. Unrest is rising across the enemy's lands.
Poison Their Wells

Under cover of night, our agents foul the wells of [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. Sickness spreads through its people, and any army camped there will suffer for it.
Sap Their Garrison

Our saboteurs slip into [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]], spoiling the grain stores and spreading sickness through the barracks. Its garrison is weakened and shaken.
Spread the Plague

We drive the sick and the dying toward the enemy's lands around [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. The plague spreads, though our own army does not escape it entirely.
Mystery Brew
The brew goes down like liquid fire and settles in the belly as courage. By morning the whole army is spoiling for a fight.
Mystery Brew
Whatever was in that barrel, it was not meant for drinking. The army wakes with sore heads and slow feet, and the keeper will not say what it was.
Dice with Strangers
The dice land in our favour, again and again. The strangers pay up with sour faces, and our stake comes back doubled.
Dice with Strangers
The dice turn against us, and the strangers sweep our stake from the table. Only later does anyone wonder whose dice they were.
Arm-Wrestle the Champion
The table groans and the crowd roars as the champion's arm slams down. Our lord walks out a legend of the common room.
Arm-Wrestle the Champion
The champion grins, leans in, and something in our lord's arm gives way with a crack. Our lord leaves the table hurt, and the crowd cheers the champion.
Buy Rumours

The keeper leans close and talks of the roads around [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]] and beyond, and of the enemy camped nearby: [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_detail").StringValue}}[[/col]]. We will see those lands for some time yet.
Send Gifts

Our gifts are well received at [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. Their rulers speak of us more warmly now, and our envoys are welcome at their table.
Spy on Their Capital

Our spies slip into [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]] to map its walls and gates and count its garrison: [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_detail").StringValue}}[[/col]]. We will see its streets for some time yet.
Curse a Distant King

A curse falls on the treasury of the court at [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. Their wealth dwindles, and they will never know why.
Share the Find

We share what we found with our neighbours, starting with [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. Their scholars are grateful, and think better of us for it.
Point Them at Each Other

Rumours spread from [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]], carefully planted by our agents. Two rivals now eye each other with suspicion.
Sell Their Secrets

The secrets fetch a fine price in [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. But word travels, and our enemies grow closer to one another.
Ransom the Captain

Their captain is ransomed back to [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]], and the price is paid in full. Their kin will not forget the humiliation.
Chase the Routers
Our fastest troops run the fleeing enemy down before they reach safety. Among the gear they threw away to run faster is a rare item.
Chase the Routers
The fleeing enemy were bait. They turn on our pursuers in a narrow pass, and our lord takes a wound that will lay them low for a time.
Headhunt
The enemy lord fell in time, just as we vowed. Their finest possession, a rare item, now belongs to us.
Headhunt
The enemy lord lived too long, and our vow goes unfulfilled.
Blood Tally
The enemy's soldiers fell in their hundreds, and the tally is met. The promised gold is counted into our treasury.
Blood Tally
Too few of the enemy fell, and the tally comes up short.
Hold the Line
Our line bent but never broke, and few of our units were lost. The reward for holding firm goes straight to our treasury.
Hold the Line
Our line held in the end, but too many of our units were lost along the way.
Swift Victory
The battle was over almost before it began. Word of the swift victory spreads, and an extra item comes our way.
Swift Victory
The battle dragged on too long for the victory to be called swift.
Guard the Standard
The marked unit stood firm through the worst of the fighting. They return as hardened veterans, 3 ranks the wiser.
Guard the Standard
The marked unit was lost in the fighting, and their sacrifice earns no reward.
Break Them
Unit after unit of theirs broke and fled before us. Every one that ran adds to the purse we were promised.
Break Them
Too few of their units broke, and they fought on to the bitter end.
Trophy Hunt
Their finest unit fell to our blades. Its survivors are pressed into our service, and a fresh unit of their kind now marches with our army.
Trophy Hunt
Their finest unit survived the battle, and the trophy slips through our fingers.
Silence the Guns
Their guns fell silent before they could do much harm. Picking through the wrecked carriages, we find a rare item.
Silence the Guns
Their guns kept firing for too long, and the mission has failed.
Bloodbath Wager
The field ran red, and the wager is won. The gold comes back to us many times over.
Bloodbath Wager
Too few of the enemy fell, and the gold we wagered is lost.
Duellist's Challenge
Our lord met theirs blade to blade and struck them down. A unique item is pried from the fallen lord's grip.
Duellist's Challenge
Our lord did not slay theirs, and the challenge goes unanswered.
Spare the Captain
Their lord was taken alive, just as we planned. The ransom has been paid, and the gold is ours.
Spare the Captain
Their lord fell in the fighting, so there is no one left to ransom.
Lord's Glory
Our lord carved through the enemy ranks, and the tally of the slain is sung around every fire. A rare item is taken from the field.
Lord's Glory
Our lord fought well, but not well enough for the songs.
Monster Slayer
Every beast they brought lies dead on the field. The bounty on such creatures is paid to us in full.
Monster Slayer
Some of their beasts still live, and the hunt is unfinished.
Steadfast
Not one of our units broke, however hard the enemy pressed. The promised gold reaches our treasury before the dead are buried.
Steadfast
One of our units broke and ran, and the vow broke with it.
Decapitate
Their lord and every one of their heroes lie dead. Searching the bodies, we turn up a unique item.
Decapitate
Some of their leaders escaped the slaughter.
Against the Odds
Outnumbered, we fought and won all the same. The promised gold is paid out, and the soldiers who earned it toast the victory.
Against the Odds
We did not face the odds we swore to beat.
Rout the Riders
Their riders scattered before us in time. Among the abandoned saddles we find a rare item.
Rout the Riders
Their riders held their nerve for too long.
Untouchable
Our lord came through the thick of the fighting barely scratched, and the army will not stop talking about it. The day's fighting has taught our lord a great deal.
Untouchable
Our lord took too many wounds for the vow to hold.
Flawless Victory
Not a single unit of ours was lost. Songs of the flawless victory spread far, and a unique item is ours.
Flawless Victory
One of our units fell before the end, and there will be no songs of a flawless victory.
Missions
The battle was fought without our watchful eyes on it, so none of our missions could be judged. Any gold we wagered is returned to our treasury.
The Price Is Paid
The price of what we took comes due at once. Our lord is struck down by a wound that will take 2 turns to heal.
The Price Is Paid
The price of what we took comes due at once. Our lord is struck down by a wound that will take 3 turns to heal.
The Price Is Paid
The price of what we took comes due at once. Our lord is struck down by a wound that will take 5 turns to heal.
A Boon Is Won

Something has changed in [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_boon_lord").StringValue}}[[/col]]'s army, and for the better. Every warrior can feel it.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]How boons grow[[/col]]\\n- A boon grows one level for every 5 battles this lord wins, up to level 5.\\n- Lost battles do not count, but they never take a level away.\\n- A charged boon does not grow. It lasts a set number of battles, then fades.\\n- Gaining a boon this lord already has raises it a level, or refills its charges.\\n\\nHow many boons and curses a lord can carry is set on the Boons and Curses page of the mod's settings. A lord who dies or leaves the faction loses them all.
The Boon Grows

Another victory, and [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_boon_lord").StringValue}}[[/col]]'s army has grown stronger for it.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]How boons grow[[/col]]\\n- A boon grows one level for every 5 battles this lord wins, up to level 5.\\n- Lost battles do not count, but they never take a level away.\\n- A charged boon does not grow. It lasts a set number of battles, then fades.\\n- Gaining a boon this lord already has raises it a level, or refills its charges.
A Boon Fades

Whatever gave [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_boon_lord").StringValue}}[[/col]]'s army its edge is gone now.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Why boons fade[[/col]]\\n- A charged boon fades after its last battle.\\n- A boon given up to make room for a new one is gone for good, with every level it gained.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Where boons come from[[/col]]\\n- A win in a hard LEAPOI battle, or one with battle modifiers\\n- A battle modifier that lingers after the fight\\n- A fallen tower champion\\n- Tavern bounties and quest chains\\n- Pacts at treasure spots, Towers and Taverns
A Curse Takes Hold

A shadow has fallen over [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_boon_lord").StringValue}}[[/col]]'s army, and it will not lift on its own.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]How curses grow[[/col]]\\n- A curse worsens one level every 5 turns, up to level 5.\\n- Some curses turn into a boon after 10 turns at their worst. The rest stay until lifted.\\n- When this lord has no room for another curse, the mildest one worsens instead.\\n\\nHow many boons and curses a lord can carry is set on the Boons and Curses page of the mod's settings. The Curse Deepens
